verdicts.why: Warren is shown as one of Xavier's first X-Men: in Xavier's memories in 'Xavier Remembers' and in the X-Men photo in X-Men '97 S1 episode 1; in 'Obsession' he refuses to rejoin. A past group the screen shows; under HANDOFF (mistake 26) a group left before the first title still counts. Placed first, before the Horsemen.

'Cold Comfort' tells that Lorna and Iceman left the X-Men after she nearly died on a mission, before she joined X-Factor, and X-Men '97 S2 episode 2 calls Polaris someone 'who used to be a member of the X-Men'. A past group told on screen, so it counts. Placed first.

Young Nathan being raised and told his destiny by Mother Askani is not shown as serving a group: 'Clan Askani' is a comics/wiki label, and the screen names only the person, Mother Askani. Putting the stage after The X-Men in S1 would also read as Cable leaving the X-Men for it. An unsure case keeps the record.

In Blade: Trinity King says Danica Talos turned him into her 'little vampire cabana boy' until the Nightstalkers cured him. That is forced service among Danica's vampires, and forced service counts. The screen doesn't name the group, so the dataset's 'The House of Talos' (Danica's own record) is used. It comes before the Nightstalkers.

In the pilot, Krista is a soldier just back from military service in Iraq, so it's a past group told on screen. The branch is never named, so the dataset's existing 'U.S. Military' is used. Placed before the House of Chthon.

Blade II: seeing her father's disregard for his children, Nyssa betrays Damaskinos by sealing off his escape, so Nomak kills him, and the Bloodpack is already wiped out. Turning on the group is a move, made before her death. Per the proposal's note, add 'Blade II' to left as well, as Blade's record has.

The record is on file for Deadpool & Wolverine: in the Void, Gambit names the Punisher among the Resistance's dead ('every time one of us has gone up against her'). Membership comes after his first title, and dying is not a departure. This matches the accepted Daredevil and Elektra Resistance stages. Left stays The Punisher (2004).

Runaways S3 episode 9 ('The Broken Circle'): Geoffrey calls the PRIDE members together to save Molly. Leslie comes, drives them in her church van disguised with CDC logos, and helps at the Hostel. She is back in the reassembled PRIDE, so a [The Pride, Runaways S3] stage after the church is right.

In S3 Dale moves to a tent on the Church of Gibborim's compound as one of its parishioners. Reunited with Stacey, he gives that up, and in episode 9 both Yorkes rejoin the reassembled PRIDE, with Dale making the anti-magic serum. The church stage is Dale's alone, which the step should say, since the file holds both.

In 'Kingdom' (S1 episode 5), a 1999 prison scene shows Geoffrey jailed with Darius for the gang's killing of Osiris. Darius took over 'his old turf' when Geoffrey walked away, and in 'Old School' Geoffrey recalls the gang's 'code... a brotherhood'. A past group the screen shows, under the dataset's existing name for Darius's gang, 'The Crips'.

Agent Carter S2 episode 4 ('Smoke & Mirrors'), 1940: Peggy works at Bletchley Park, named on screen and in her own step, before she leaves it for the SOE. A past employer counts as a group, so it goes first, before SOE.

Cloak & Dagger episode 5 ('Princeton Offense'): O'Reilly tells of making drug busts in Harlem as a detective, and Connors calls her 'New York'. She was a New York cop before moving to the NOPD. The dataset's 'NYPD' is the existing name, and it goes before the NOPD.

Bucky leaves no group in Civil War: he has been Independent since breaking from HYDRA in The Winter Soldier, fights beside Steve in no named group, and ends the film taking asylum in Wakanda, where his Wakanda stage starts. Drop 'Captain America: Civil War' from left and keep 'Captain America: The Winter Soldier'. Groups unchanged.

The S7 Coulson is a Chronicom LMD with Coulson's memories (his own MCU-wiki page). HANDOFF lets an LMD give a step, but the person's own record stays real, and that step is rightly 'Deceased'. The real Coulson retired from S.H.I.E.L.D. in S5 and died, so the LMD's service is not his stage. The record stays as it is.

Thor: Ragnarok names the group ('The Valkyrie are legend. Elite warriors of Asgard, sworn to defend the throne'), and a scene of the past shows her riding with them against Hela. All but her are killed, so the group ends, and she leaves Asgard for Sakaar. A past group the screen shows and names.

In Vol. 2 Nebula is already in no group: she is the Guardians' prisoner, then helps Taserface's mutineers only as an ally for a bounty, then fights Ego. At the end she declines to stay and goes after Thanos, so she leaves no group. The second Independent stage and the Vol. 2 left go, which matches T:nebula's groups. T:nebula's left still lists Vol. 2 and should drop it too.

In Black Panther, Shuri sums him up as 'Everett Ross, former Air Force pilot, now CIA', and he flies the Talon remotely. A past group told on screen under the existing 'U.S. Air Force' name. It goes first, before the CIA, in story order, like Peggy's SOE stage.
